SELECT no, title, latitude, longitude, thumbnail, ratingSum, reviewCount, attraction_type_name as attractionTypeName, address FROM attractions WHERE 1=1
AND attraction_type_name IN
#{type}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY
ratingSum DESC reviewCount DESC no DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}

SELECT no, title, overview, map_level as mapLevel, latitude, longitude, tel, address, address_detail as addressDetail, homepage, api_id as apiId, thumbnail, ratingSum, reviewCount, attraction_type_name as attractionTypeName, overview FROM attractions WHERE no = #{attractionNo}

SELECT no, image_url as imageUrl, review_image_order as reviewImageOrder, attraction_no as attractionNo, attraction_review_no as attractionReviewNo FROM attraction_image WHERE attraction_no = #{attractionNo} ORDER BY review_image_order ASC
SELECT no, plan_post_no as planPostNo, name FROM plan_post_tag WHERE plan_post_no = #{planPostNo}

SELECT a.no, a.title, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.thumbnail, a.ratingSum, a.reviewCount, a.attraction_type_name as attractionTypeName, a.address FROM attractions a INNER JOIN bookmark b ON a.no = b.attraction_no WHERE b.bookmark_type_no = #{bookmarkTypeNo} ORDER BY b.order ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
